description: dcepa95's Claude Code skills: timesheet-calendar rebuilds worked hours from git history and Claude Code sessions and adds them as blocks to a private Google Calendar that Productive reads, with a daily macOS reminder. ship gets a branch ready for review and writes the PR description in your voice. ticket turns a ticket into an agreed implementation plan.
